questions.question: In David's psalm about a mighty man who brags, what does David say the man boasts of?
In David's psalm about a boastful man, what does David say God will surely do to him?

answers.text: Bring him down to everlasting ruin
Strike him with a lasting plague
Bind him in chains of darkness

questions.question: David said the righteous would mock a man who did not make God his refuge. What did the man trust instead?
In his psalm about a boastful man, David says he trusts in the loving devotion of God forever and ever. True or false?
